name: supersede-decomposed
why:
Second arm of the co-adaptation experiment, on the other wide gap. `test-preflight` scored 47% open-weight against 100% premium on the monolithic probe, and its failures split by size: small models never emitted the labels, large ones emitted them wrong.

Decomposed the same way as `ac-coverage-decomposed`: two binary questions per existing test, and the keep/update/delete label computed in code. The two questions are the ones the duty actually turns on — does this test exercise the changed behaviour at all, and does the new AC contradict what it asserts. Neither requires the model to know the label vocabulary.

Prediction worth recording before the run, so it can be wrong: this should help small models more than `ac-coverage` did, because half of test-preflight's failures were format rather than judgement and a one-word contract removes that class outright.

criteria.T1: T1 — `getById throws NotFoundException when the order is missing`
criteria.T2: T2 — `getById returns the order when it exists`
